obfuscation_indicators: not all costs can be fully mitigated
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and data-rich, with extensive market statistics, segment drivers, pricing trends, and quantified year-over-year changes. Risk tone is balanced but mildly cautious, reflecting weaker sales, lower log and wood-product prices, inflation, interest-rate sensitivity, and mixed export demand, partially offset by improving housing activity and longer-term favorable market expectations. Some forward-looking claims and broad mitigating language introduce moderate uncertainty.
